observations.observation: Kingsbridge used a 2-3-2-3 build-up shape with the left-back inverting inside 34% of the time, creating a back three in build-up that shifts width to the wingers.
observations.consequence: This structure provides better protection against counters by adding midfield presence, but requires the opposing winger to track inside or concede central pressure.
observations.coachAction: Opposing winger tracks inside tightly to exploit space left wide.

observations.observation: Kingsbridge balanced attacks down all flanks, with 32% left, 34% centre, and 34% right, but after substituting Marchetti at 71', right flank use dropped from 48% to 26%.
observations.consequence: The shift reduces right-side threat, allowing defense to focus more on left and centre attacks.
observations.coachAction: Adjust defense to reinforce left and central areas while guarding reduced right threat.

observations.observation: Kingsbridge maintained a mid-height compact block 30 m deep, with PPDA 5.5 press intensity and 35% counter-press success, but after substitute Marchetti arrival their defensive line dropped 5 m deeper (37 to 32 m).
observations.consequence: Deeper defensive line may concede more space behind but increases solidity; pressing effectiveness sustained despite deeper position.
observations.coachAction: Exploit space behind deep line with long balls or quick transitions.

observations.observation: Northgate played with a back three via Duarte (6) dropping between centre-backs in 58% of build-up phases, using a 2-3-5 shape mainly attacking through the centre (54%).
observations.consequence: This created a clean first pass and midfield body cost, focusing attacks centrally.
observations.coachAction: Press with three forwards or block passes into midfield.

observations.observation: Northgate defended with a 34 m deep block and last line 28 m from goal, pressing moderately with PPDA 4.5.
observations.consequence: A moderately deep, compact block makes penetrating difficult but concedes some midfield space.
observations.coachAction: Attempt to play through lines or switch play to stretch their block.

observations.observation: At 61 minutes Northgate switched from 4-3-3 to 4-4-2, bringing on Petrov (10), which pulled their defensive line deeper from 29 m to 23 m.
observations.consequence: A tactical shift that compressed defensive space and likely aimed to protect a lead or change dynamics.
observations.coachAction: Adjust to the new formation and possibly double up on fresh attacking zones.
